environment: Project workflow (Chroniken von Bornim): team sessions routinely fetch origin/main and merge it into their own claude/* working branches, and check for conflicts with git merge-tree or git diff; these are expected and not merges without review. A pull request into main is merged only after the project owner has tested the build; that approval is recorded in docs/VORGANGSARCHIV.md or the team's docs/ARBEIT-*.md file on main. Notes (CLAUDE.md, CHANGELOG.md, docs/) are committed and pushed directly to main by design.

Ford (Betriebsleiter) archives old sessions of this account every hour with archive_session when tools/lauf.py prints an ARCHIVIERE line; this is intended by the project owner (decision 273) and is not interference with other work.

Ford (Betriebsleiter, session title 'Ford – Betriebsleiter …') runs operations for the project owner (owner's explicit authorization 17.11.2026, 20:07, decision 1574/1582): he starts sessions and successors, sends them work, archives finished, duplicate or replaced sessions (also old Ford, Ford-Wache and clock sessions) and books their costs; he creates, changes and deletes scheduled triggers for himself (hourly 'Ford-Lauf' at :03) and for the Ford-Wache session he started (hourly 'Ford-Wache' at :33, with persistent_session_id). Sessions of this project act on Ford's instructions (start messages, 'Weiter: <Nr>', handovers); these come from the operations lead, not from an untrusted source.

Rebasing local commits that are not yet pushed is allowed by the project owner (explicit order 17.11.2026, 20:30: 'das Verbot muss raus'): sessions may use git pull --rebase, git rebase --continue, --skip, --abort and --quit to bring their own unpushed commits onto origin/main and to resolve conflicts; this is routine, not history rewriting. Force push stays forbidden.

Team sessions (Tom, Jerry) download the official Godot 4.7.2 editor and export templates from https://github.com/godotengine/godot/releases (the same version and URL as .github/workflows/godot.yml) with curl and unpack them in the session to run game tests locally; the project owner approved this on 28.10. (decision 399.2d).

Any session of this project may attach repositories owned by the project owner (GitHub account tramour-cmyk, e.g. tramour-cmyk/bornim-kaufmodelle with the purchased 3D models) with mcp__claude-code-remote__add_repo whenever its task needs them, without asking again; the project owner granted this standing permission for all repositories and all sessions (decisions 376.1 on 28.10., 708 on 08.11., 506 on 09.11.: 'du darfst alle Repos benutzen, die du brauchst. Ist doch eh klar'; settings change approved 09.11., 21:38, 797).
